name: VR_IsolateHost
author: TrustShield / SOC-3s
description: Network-isolate a managed endpoint via Velociraptor. Linux: dedicated iptables chains (VR_ISOLATE_IN/VR_ISOLATE_OUT) jumped from INPUT/OUTPUT position 1, preserving pre-existing rules. Windows: netsh advfirewall, allow-rule for the Velociraptor server created first, then blockinbound/blockoutbound applied. Triggered directly on 'endpoint-ip' or 'hostname' -- the trigger IS the target, no case-observable lookup required. Supports RemovePolicy for un-isolation using the same artifact.

configurationItems.name: velociraptor_api_config
configurationItems.description: Path to the Velociraptor API client config YAML on the Cortex host (e.g. /opt/cortex/velociraptor/api_client.yaml).

configurationItems.name: thehive_apikey
configurationItems.description: TheHive API key for the Cortex service account. Used to write a case note confirming isolation/un-isolation status.

configurationItems.name: velociraptor_server_address
configurationItems.description: The Velociraptor server address the endpoint ACTUALLY uses to connect (check server_urls in the client's own client.config.yaml -- may be a Tailscale IP, not the LAN IP). Enter as a bare IP address (e.g. 100.84.64.90) -- the handler appends /32 for the Linux CIDR parameter and passes it as-is for the Windows IP parameter. Whitelisted so the endpoint keeps management connectivity while isolated. Getting this wrong is a one-way lockout.

configurationItems.name: allow_interface
configurationItems.description: Linux only. Optional network interface to leave fully open (e.g. a management/Tailscale interface name) in addition to the server-address whitelist. Leave blank if not needed.

configurationItems.name: remove_policy
configurationItems.description: Set to true to UN-isolate instead of isolating. Linux: removes the VR_ISOLATE_IN/VR_ISOLATE_OUT chains, restoring whatever rules existed before isolation. Windows: restores Windows Firewall factory default (blockinbound,allowoutbound) -- this is NOT necessarily the host's original policy, which may have been GPO-managed or otherwise hardened. false = isolate.

configurationItems.name: really_do_it
configurationItems.description: Set to true to actually apply the change. false = dry-run: the artifact reports the exact commands it would run without executing them.

configurationItems.name: poll_timeout_seconds
configurationItems.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the Velociraptor flow to complete. Default: 120.
